title: Power to write off irrecoverable amounts

versions.Latest:
186. Power to write off irrecoverable amounts.—

—   Subject   to   such restriction as 
may be prescribed; a Panchayat may write off any tax, fee, rate or other amount 
whatsoever due to it, whether under a contract or otherwise, or any sum payable in 
connection therewith if, in its opinion, such tax, fee, rate or other amount or sum is 
irrecoverable.
